Signature Service

Ashiatsu.
Barefoot massage.
The deepest pressure
you've probably ever felt.

Ashiatsu is a form of massage where I use my feet — supported by overhead bars — instead of my hands. The result is pressure that is uniquely consistent, deeply sustained, and capable of reaching tissue that hands simply cannot.

Clients describe it as "feeling like two people are working on you at the same time." First-timers are usually surprised. Then they rebook.

Ashiatsu is particularly effective for deep fascial work, chronic tension patterns, and anyone who carries dense muscle tissue and has never found a therapist who could get there.

"The deepest most comfortable pressure ever. 1st time doing this type of massage and I can't wait for my next one."

— Matt Schram

Who It's For

— You've spent years telling massage therapists "a little deeper" and still never found the pressure you needed.
— You carry a lot of dense muscle tissue from training, labor, or years of physical work.
— You have chronic fascial restrictions that haven't responded to standard massage.
— You want to know what it actually feels like to have tissue fully addressed — not just worked on the surface.
Book an Ashiatsu Session
